description: Event rules from Trojan Event Services (Terms and Conditions, FAQ, tabling page), the Student Handbook 2026-27 and the Social Dance Approval Process, plus the academic calendar pointer.

rules.title: USC academic calendar 2026-27 (dates used for deadlines)
rules.owner_office: Office of Academic Records and Registrar
rules.source: USC Academic Calendar (Office of Academic Records and Registrar)
rules.source_section: Academic Calendar 2026-2027
rules.source_text: Spring Semester 2027 73 instructional days Open Registration Thu-Fri January 7-8 Classes Begin Mon January 11 Martin Luther King Jr. Day Holiday Mon January 18 President’s Day Holiday Mon February 15 Spring Recess Sun-Sun March 14-21 Classes End Fri April 30 Study Days Sat-Tue May 1-4 Exams Wed-Wed May 5-12 Commencement Wed-Sat May 12-15
rules.message: Greenlight uses USC's 2026-27 academic calendar for holidays, breaks, study days and finals. A person confirmed every date against the official calendar on November 14, 2026.
rules.applies_to: Every date computed from the academic calendar
rules.notes: rules/calendar.json holds the dates; its verification must match this rule's (scripts/validate_rules.py checks). Confirmed by a human (the user) on 2026-11-14, directly in the Phase 0 session: every date in rules/calendar.json had been compared with https://www.usc.edu/academic-calendar/ and matched.

rules.title: What counts as a business day
rules.owner_office: Office of Academic Records and Registrar
rules.source: USC Academic Calendar (Office of Academic Records and Registrar)
rules.source_section: Academic Calendar 2026-2027
rules.source_text: The Academic Calendar identifies those instructional days and those days regarded as holidays for students, graduate students and graduate student workers.
rules.verification_note: No USC source defines business days for these deadlines. Greenlight assumes Monday to Friday, minus university holidays, with recess days counted. Confirm with the office that owns the deadline.
rules.message: Some deadlines are counted in business days, but no USC source defines them. Greenlight counts Monday to Friday and skips university holidays; it counts recess days as business days. Check any business-day date with the office.
rules.fix_template: Confirm the date with the office that set the deadline.
rules.applies_to: Every deadline counted in business days
rules.notes: rules/calendar.json business_days holds the same assumption and must carry the same verification (scripts/validate_rules.py checks). Holidays come from the academic calendar; the staff holiday calendar may differ.

rules.title: Request the venue 3 to 6 weeks ahead
rules.source: USC Student Handbook 2026-27 (August 25, 2026)
rules.source_section: Appendix V: Event Planning and Facility Reservation/Use, Scheduling
rules.source_text: Requests should be made early enough—generally at least 3-6 weeks in advance—to allow adequate time for processing the request, planning the event, payment of fees and advertising. Trojan Event Services has the requested date deadlines on their website. No advertisement can take place before written confirmation is received.
rules.message: Request the space from Trojan Event Services generally at least 3 to 6 weeks before the event. Greenlight uses 6 weeks, the earlier end of the range.
rules.fix_template: Submit the venue request by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: An event in a venue booked through Trojan Event Services

params.range_quote: generally at least 3-6 weeks in advance

rules.notes: The Handbook gives a range ('generally'), not a hard deadline, so this is shown yellow rather than red.

rules.title: Spring 2027 venue requests open September 15, 2026
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES): Frequently Asked Questions
rules.source_section: Frequently Asked Questions: When can I start booking for my meetings and events?
rules.source_text: For SPRING SEMESTER Meetings and Events Recognized Student Organizations can submit requests starting September 15, 2026.
rules.message: Clubs could request Trojan Event Services venues for Spring 2027 from September 15, 2026.
rules.applies_to: Spring 2027 events in Trojan Event Services venues

rules.title: No club events in the first weeks of spring
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES): Frequently Asked Questions
rules.source_section: Frequently Asked Questions: When can I start booking for my meetings and events?
rules.source_text: (RSOs can not host events the first 3 weeks of the January. Events can start after January 26.)
rules.message: Clubs cannot host events in the first 3 weeks of the spring semester. Trojan Event Services says events can start after January 26, 2027.
rules.fix_template: Move the event to February 1, 2027 or later, or confirm a date from January 27 to 31 with Trojan Event Services first.
rules.applies_to: Any club event in a Trojan Event Services venue dated on or before January 26, 2027
rules.notes: The page says both 'the first 3 weeks' and 'after January 26'. Spring classes begin January 11, 2027, so three full weeks would end January 31. Greenlight blocks through January 26 (the stated date) and shows January 27-31 as yellow: confirm with Trojan Event Services.

rules.title: University Event Permit Application (UEPA) for every campus event
rules.source: USC Student Handbook 2026-27 (August 25, 2026)
rules.source_section: Appendix V: Event Planning and Facility Reservation/Use, Scheduling
rules.source_text: Once Trojan Event Services or the applicable facilities manager has confirmed that space is available, event organizers are required to submit a University Event Permit Application (UEPA).
rules.message: Once the space is confirmed, submit a University Event Permit Application (UEPA). Offices with an interest in the event review it.
rules.fix_template: Submit the UEPA as soon as the space is confirmed, and by {due_date} at the latest.
rules.applies_to: Every event in campus space

rules.title: All approvals in place 2 weeks before
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES) Terms and Conditions 2026
rules.source_section: Terms and Conditions A.6: Required Approvals
rules.source_text: The University may cancel the event if all required approvals have not been obtained at least two weeks before the event.
rules.message: Every required approval must be in place at least 2 weeks before the event, or the University may cancel it.
rules.fix_template: Get every approval by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: Every event booked through Trojan Event Services

rules.title: Late permit applications: exceptional cases only
rules.source: USC Student Handbook 2026-27 (August 25, 2026)
rules.source_section: Appendix V: Event Planning and Facility Reservation/Use, Scheduling
rules.source_text: In the event that a request to reserve space has not been timely submitted, the university may nevertheless consider a UEPA under the following exceptional circumstances only: (1) there was no reasonable way to anticipate the need for the event in time to reserve the space with the advance time ordinarily required (e.g., a vigil or demonstration about a matter that occurred only a few days earlier); (2) the time, place, and manner of the event would not interfere with any other scheduled events or university functions; and (3) the UEPA has been submitted sufficiently in advance of the event (typically at least 48 hours) to allow the university to address any health, safety, or logistical issues or concerns.
rules.message: A late permit application is considered only in exceptional cases, such as an event that could not have been foreseen, and typically at least 48 hours ahead. The university decides.
rules.fix_template: If a deadline has passed, contact Trojan Event Services and Campus Activities as soon as possible.
rules.applies_to: An event whose space request or permit is late

rules.title: Contact the Department of Public Safety 2 weeks before
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES) Terms and Conditions 2026
rules.source_section: Terms and Conditions A.6.i: Security
rules.source_text: i. Security: The Department of Public Safety (DPS). Purchaser must contact the USC Department of Public Safety no less than two weeks before the event. DPS will determine whether the event will require any fees and special security to protect the University’s property, students, faculty, staff and visitor.
rules.message: Contact the Department of Public Safety (DPS) at least 2 weeks before the event. DPS decides whether security staff or fees are needed.
rules.fix_template: Contact DPS by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: Every event booked through Trojan Event Services

rules.title: Security requirements are set by DPS
rules.source: USC Student Handbook 2026-27 (August 25, 2026)
rules.source_section: Appendix V: Security
rules.source_text: Fencing, staffing, identification checks, and the need for other security requirements will be determined by the Department of Public Safety and the University Events Committee, using considerations including but not limited to the history of the event, scale of the event, nature of the event, liability and risk, health considerations, construction, and sponsorship.
rules.message: Fencing, staffing, ID checks and other security needs are decided by the Department of Public Safety and the University Events Committee. There is no published ratio or fee table.
rules.applies_to: Events with security needs

rules.title: Final payment 21 days before
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES) Terms and Conditions 2026
rules.source_section: Terms and Conditions C.3: Recognized USC Student Organizations
rules.source_text: viii. For all venues: Failure to remit the Deposit may result in the cancellation of your reservation hold. Final payment is due from Purchaser twenty‐one (21) days prior to the event date. Payment must be in the form of a cashier’s check, money order, internal requisition or credit card (Visa, MasterCard, Discover) only. Cash, personal or group checks are not accepted.
rules.message: Final payment to Trojan Event Services is due 21 days before the event, or the reservation is cancelled. Cash and personal checks are not accepted.
rules.fix_template: Pay Trojan Event Services by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: An event with Trojan Event Services charges (ballroom, Bovard, outdoor venues, staffing)

rules.title: Venue deposits for clubs
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES) Terms and Conditions 2026
rules.source_section: Terms and Conditions C.3: Recognized USC Student Organizations
rules.source_text: v. RTCC Events: There is no cost for USC recognized student organizations to use the RTCC meeting rooms. For use of the Trojan Grand Ballroom, a non‐refundable deposit of $300.00 is due 5 business days after the initial processing of your Event Status Report (ESR) (the “Deposit”). vi. Bovard Events: A non‐refundable deposit of $300.00 is due 5 business days after the initial processing of your event request (the “Deposit”). vii. Outdoor Events: A non‐refundable deposit of $100.00 is due 5 business days after the initial processing of your event request (the “Deposit”). Late cancellations and no shows will result in a loss of the deposit.
rules.message: Campus Center meeting rooms are free for clubs. The Trojan Grand Ballroom and Bovard need a $300 non-refundable deposit and outdoor venues $100, due 5 business days after the request is processed.
rules.applies_to: Events in Trojan Event Services venues

rules.title: Audio-visual arrangements 3 weeks before
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES) Terms and Conditions 2026
rules.source_section: Terms and Conditions B.1: Audio/Visual equipment
rules.source_text: A/V arrangements must be finalized at least three (3) weeks prior to your event. Additional staffing and rental fees apply to most A/V requests. Any changes made less than three weeks in advance of the event date are subject to resource availability and surcharges.
rules.message: Finalize audio-visual arrangements with Trojan Event Services at least 3 weeks before the event. Later changes depend on availability and cost extra.
rules.fix_template: Finalize audio-visual needs by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: An event using Trojan Event Services audio-visual equipment

rules.title: Decorations approved 3 weeks before (Terms and Conditions)
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES) Terms and Conditions 2026
rules.source_section: Terms and Conditions B.4: Decorations
rules.source_text: All decorations require pre‐approval from Trojan Event Services at least three weeks prior to the event.
rules.message: The Terms and Conditions require decorations to be approved by Trojan Event Services at least 3 weeks before the event.
rules.fix_template: Get decorations approved by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: An event with decorations in the venue
rules.notes: Sources disagree: the Terms and Conditions say 3 weeks, the FAQ says 2 weeks. Greenlight applies the stricter 3 weeks and shows both.

rules.title: Decorations approved 2 weeks before (FAQ)
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES): Frequently Asked Questions
rules.source_section: Frequently Asked Questions: What's your policy on decorations in the venue?
rules.source_text: Decorations: All decorations require approval from Trojan Event Services at least two weeks prior to the event.
rules.message: The Trojan Event Services FAQ says decorations need approval at least 2 weeks before the event.
rules.fix_template: Get decorations approved by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: An event with decorations in the venue
rules.notes: Sources disagree: the Terms and Conditions say 3 weeks, the FAQ says 2 weeks. Greenlight applies the stricter 3 weeks and shows both.

rules.title: Decorations that are never allowed
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES): Frequently Asked Questions
rules.source_section: Frequently Asked Questions: What's your policy on decorations in the venue?
rules.source_text: Prohibited items: Taping, stapling, gluing or otherwise attaching items to any walls, doors, curtains, windows, posts, columns, floors or ceilings. Glitter and confetti. Fog machines and bubble machines. Candles, flames of any kind, pyrotechnics.
rules.message: Not allowed: taping, stapling or gluing to walls, doors, windows, floors or ceilings; glitter and confetti; fog and bubble machines; candles, flames and pyrotechnics.
rules.fix_template: Remove {item} from the decoration plan.
rules.applies_to: An event with decorations in the venue

rules.title: Room set-up changes until 2 weeks before
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES) Terms and Conditions 2026
rules.source_section: Terms and Conditions B.6: Room Configurations
rules.source_text: Minor changes can be made to the room set up until two weeks prior to the event and subject to approval.
rules.message: Minor changes to the room set-up can be made until 2 weeks before the event; later changes only if staff are available, and fees may apply.
rules.fix_template: Confirm the room set-up by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: An indoor Trojan Event Services venue

rules.title: Disclose outside rentals 3 weeks before
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES) Terms and Conditions 2026
rules.source_section: Terms and Conditions R: Rental Equipment from Non-USC Vendors
rules.source_text: All rentals from outside vendors must be disclosed at least three (3) weeks prior to the event. Items such as staging, tents, plants, flowers, balloons, dance floors, audio‐visual equipment, etc., are permissible with prior approval. Vendors not already approved by the University must provide proof of Liability Insurance prior to the event.
rules.message: Tell Trojan Event Services about every rental from an outside vendor (staging, tents, dance floor, audio-visual) at least 3 weeks before. Vendors not approved by USC must show liability insurance.
rules.fix_template: Send the rental list to Trojan Event Services by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: An event with equipment rented from outside vendors

rules.title: Tables and chairs 2 weeks before
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES): Frequently Asked Questions
rules.source_section: Frequently Asked Questions: Where can I get tables and chairs for my event?
rules.source_text: Requests for tables and other services must be made at least two weeks in advance of your event date.
rules.message: Request tables, chairs and other services from Facilities Management Services at least 2 weeks before the event, using the checklist on the Trojan Event Services Forms and Permits page.
rules.fix_template: Submit the Facilities Management Services checklist by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: An event that needs tables and chairs

rules.title: Classroom requests open in week 4
rules.source: Campus Activities: RSO Resources
rules.source_section: Space Requests
rules.source_text: Classroom Scheduling accepts requests for classroom spaces starting Week 4.
rules.message: Classroom Scheduling accepts classroom requests only from week 4 of the semester, so a classroom event cannot be booked earlier.
rules.fix_template: Hold the event in week 4 or later, or use a Trojan Event Services venue.
rules.applies_to: An event in a classroom

rules.title: Cancel a meeting room 2 weeks before
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES) Terms and Conditions 2026
rules.source_section: Terms and Conditions D.1.ii: Cancellation Deadlines
rules.source_text: ii. Meeting rooms – must be cancelled two weeks prior to the event to avoid penalty.
rules.message: To cancel a Campus Center meeting room without a fee, cancel in writing at least 2 weeks before.
rules.fix_template: Last day to cancel without a fee: {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: A Campus Center meeting room

rules.title: Cancel a large or outdoor venue 3 weeks before (Terms and Conditions)
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES) Terms and Conditions 2026
rules.source_section: Terms and Conditions D.1.iii: Cancellation Deadlines
rules.source_text: iii. Trojan Grand Ballroom/Bovard Auditorium/Tommy’s Place/Traditions/Outdoor Venues – must be cancelled at least three weeks in advance of the date of the event.
rules.message: The Terms and Conditions say large and outdoor venues must be cancelled at least 3 weeks before the event.
rules.fix_template: Last day to cancel without a fee: {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: Bovard, the Trojan Grand Ballroom, Tommy's Place, Traditions or an outdoor venue
rules.notes: Sources disagree: the Terms and Conditions say 3 weeks, the FAQ says 4 weeks. Greenlight applies the stricter 4 weeks and shows both.

rules.title: Cancel a large or outdoor venue 4 weeks before (FAQ)
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES): Frequently Asked Questions
rules.source_section: Frequently Asked Questions: How do I cancel my reservation?
rules.source_text: For Bovard, Trojan Grand Ballroom Tommy’s Place/Traditions, and Outdoor Events, all cancellations need to be made four weeks in advance.
rules.message: The Trojan Event Services FAQ says cancellations for these venues must be made 4 weeks in advance.
rules.fix_template: Last day to cancel without a fee: {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: Bovard, the Trojan Grand Ballroom, Tommy's Place, Traditions or an outdoor venue
rules.notes: Sources disagree: the Terms and Conditions say 3 weeks, the FAQ says 4 weeks. Greenlight applies the stricter 4 weeks and shows both.

rules.title: No social events on study days or during finals
rules.source: USC Student Handbook 2026-27 (August 25, 2026)
rules.source_section: Appendix V: Event Planning and Facility Reservation/Use
rules.source_text: No social events may take place during university study days or final exams.
rules.message: Social events cannot take place on study days or during final exams.
rules.fix_template: Move the event out of study days and finals ({blocked_start} to {blocked_end}).
rules.applies_to: A social event or dance

rules.title: Social event end times
rules.source: USC Student Handbook 2026-27 (August 25, 2026)
rules.source_section: Appendix V: Event Planning and Facility Reservation/Use
rules.source_text: Social events without alcohol provided by the host student organization are permitted Sunday through Thursday until midnight and Friday through Saturday until 2 a.m. Events where alcohol is provided are restricted to Thursday – Saturday (refer to the section on Student Organization Events with Alcohol for details).
rules.message: Social events without alcohol may run until midnight Sunday to Thursday and until 2 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
rules.fix_template: End the event by {latest_end}.
rules.applies_to: A social event

rules.title: Social dance: start approval 3 months before
rules.owner_office: Trojan Event Services (TES) and Student Life
rules.source: Step-by-Step Instructions for the Student Affairs Social Dance Approval Process (2023)
rules.source_section: Student Life Social Dance Approval Process
rules.source_text: Student organization will need to start the approval process at least 3 months before the event date.
rules.message: A social dance needs Student Life approval. Start the approval process at least 3 months before the event.
rules.fix_template: Start the social dance approval by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: A social dance
rules.notes: The process document is dated 9/2023; it is the version Trojan Event Services publishes.

rules.title: Social dance: Events Meeting 7 weeks before
rules.owner_office: Trojan Event Services (TES) and Student Life
rules.source: Step-by-Step Instructions for the Student Affairs Social Dance Approval Process (2023)
rules.source_section: Student Life Social Dance Approval Process, Step 4
rules.source_text: STEP 4: EVENTS MEETING. Attend an Events Meeting at least 7 weeks before the event date.
rules.message: Present the dance at a weekly Events Meeting at least 7 weeks before the event.
rules.fix_template: Schedule the Events Meeting by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: A social dance

rules.title: Social dance: signed form 5 weeks before
rules.owner_office: Trojan Event Services (TES) and Student Life
rules.source: Step-by-Step Instructions for the Student Affairs Social Dance Approval Process (2023)
rules.source_section: Student Life Social Dance Approval Process
rules.source_text: If the Social Dance Approval Form is not received at least 5 weeks before the event date, the event is cancelled and the reservation “HOLD” is removed.
rules.message: The fully signed Social Dance Approval Form must reach Trojan Event Services at least 5 weeks before the event, or the event is cancelled.
rules.fix_template: Deliver the signed form by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: A social dance

rules.title: Register an event with alcohol
rules.source: USC Student Handbook 2026-27 (August 25, 2026)
rules.source_section: Student Organization Events with Alcohol
rules.source_text: For student organization events where alcohol is present, the event must be registered with Campus Activities (or FSL for social Greek- letter organizations).
rules.message: An event where alcohol is present must be registered with Campus Activities.
rules.fix_template: Register the event with Campus Activities.
rules.applies_to: An event with alcohol

rules.title: No alcohol at club dances
rules.source: USC Student Handbook 2026-27 (August 25, 2026)
rules.source_section: Student Organization Events with Alcohol
rules.source_text: Alcohol is not permitted at university dances sponsored by RSOs.
rules.message: Alcohol is not allowed at dances hosted by clubs.
rules.fix_template: Remove alcohol from the dance.
rules.applies_to: A social dance with alcohol

rules.title: Alcohol only Thursday to Saturday
rules.source: USC Student Handbook 2026-27 (August 25, 2026)
rules.source_section: Student Organization Events with Alcohol
rules.source_text: Events where alcohol is served by the host organization are only permitted on Thursdays, Fridays, and Saturdays. Alcohol service must end at least one hour before the event’s scheduled end time.
rules.message: Events where the club serves alcohol are allowed only on Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays, and service must end at least 1 hour before the event ends.
rules.fix_template: Move the event to a Thursday, Friday or Saturday, or remove alcohol.
rules.applies_to: An event with alcohol

rules.title: Conditions for serving alcohol
rules.source: USC Student Handbook 2026-27 (August 25, 2026)
rules.source_section: Student Organization Events with Alcohol
rules.source_text: Alcohol can only be provided and served by an approved USC vendor. • IDs must be checked by the approved vendor’s bartender. • Distribution of alcohol to persons under the age of 21 is prohibited. • The serving of alcohol to an intoxicated person or to the point of intoxication is prohibited. • The student organization must limit each attendee to a two- alcoholic drink maximum. • When alcohol is served, it is required that sufficient quantities of nonalcoholic beverages and food must be available. • Outdoor events with alcohol must include a fenced area for alcohol service and consumption, accessible only to those over 21. • Serving alcohol at events may require the presence of a Department of Public Safety (DPS) officer.
rules.message: Alcohol must be served by an approved USC vendor whose bartender checks IDs; two-drink limit; food and non-alcoholic drinks available; fenced area outdoors; a DPS officer may be required.
rules.fix_template: Book an approved USC alcohol vendor and plan the conditions listed.
rules.applies_to: An event with alcohol

rules.title: Alcohol approval in the permit application 2 weeks before
rules.source: USC Student Handbook 2026-27 (August 25, 2026)
rules.source_section: Student Organization Events with Alcohol: Alcohol approval process
rules.source_text: For alcohol approval, it must be completed by the host student organization and indicated in the University Event Permit Application (UEPA). The UEPA must be submitted at least two weeks prior to the event with designated approvals prior to the event.
rules.message: Request alcohol approval in the University Event Permit Application at least 2 weeks before the event.
rules.fix_template: Submit the permit application with the alcohol request by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: An event with alcohol

rules.title: Register events with minors 60 days before
rules.owner_office: Office of Youth Protection and Programming
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES): Frequently Asked Questions
rules.source_section: Frequently Asked Questions: Will my event with minors need to be registered?
rules.source_text: Events involving minors are required to adhere to the requirements outlined in the Protecting Minors Policy , which includes registering with the Office of Youth Protection and Programming 60 days prior to the anticipated event date.
rules.message: An event with people under 18 must be registered with the Office of Youth Protection and Programming at least 60 days before.
rules.fix_template: Register with the Office of Youth Protection and Programming by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: An event with minors attending

rules.title: Fire permit for open flame or large tents
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES): Frequently Asked Questions
rules.source_section: Frequently Asked Questions: What is a Division 5 permit?
rules.source_text: It is a permit you need to be filled out and turn in if your event contains at least one of the following: Open flame. Tents, canopies, or membrane structures with an area larger than 450 Sq Ft.
rules.message: Open flame, or a tent, canopy or membrane structure larger than 450 square feet, needs a Los Angeles Fire Department Division 5 permit.
rules.fix_template: Complete the Division 5 permit (on the Trojan Event Services Forms and Permits page).
rules.applies_to: An event with open flame or a tent
rules.notes: No lead time is published for this permit; it is one of the approvals that must be in place 2 weeks before (approvals-two-weeks).

rules.title: No candles or flames on campus
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES): Frequently Asked Questions
rules.source_section: Frequently Asked Questions: Can I use candles or sternos on campus?
rules.source_text: USC does not allow candles or flames on campus. Candles must be LED.
rules.message: Candles and flames are not allowed on campus; candles must be LED. Canned heat (Sterno) follows separate USC guidelines.
rules.fix_template: Use LED candles. For Sterno food warmers, follow the USC Sterno guidelines and ask Trojan Event Services.
rules.applies_to: An event with candles or open flame
rules.notes: The same FAQ describes a fire permit for open flame; Sterno has its own guidelines. Greenlight shows both and asks the officer to confirm with Trojan Event Services.

rules.title: Props: permit application 2 weeks before
rules.owner_office: Department of Public Safety (DPS) and Office of Risk Management
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES): Frequently Asked Questions
rules.source_section: Frequently Asked Questions: May I have props or weapons at my event?
rules.source_text: All props must be reviewed and approved by the USC Department of Public Safety and Office of Risk Management. You must notify your venue’s manager if you plan to have props at your event. You must complete a University Event Permit Application (UEPA), indicate that you will have props, clearly identify each prop and the purpose of use. All requests must be received 2 weeks prior to your event.
rules.message: Props must be approved by the Department of Public Safety and Risk Management. List each prop with photos in the University Event Permit Application at least 2 weeks before. Props must be non-metallic; no weapons.
rules.fix_template: Submit the prop list and photos by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: An event with props

rules.title: Liability waivers for higher-risk activities
rules.owner_office: Office of Risk Management and Insurance
rules.source: USC Student Handbook 2026-27 (August 25, 2026)
rules.source_section: Appendix V: Special Event Insurance for Events on Campus
rules.source_text: The Office of Risk Management and Insurance requires liability waivers if an activity in your event is considered medium to high risk. Examples of high-risk activities include a swimming or diving event, flag football, 5K run, or an inflatable obstacle course.
rules.message: Medium- or high-risk activities (swimming, flag football, a 5K run, inflatables) need liability waivers from Risk Management.
rules.fix_template: Request the USC waiver form from Trojan Event Services.
rules.applies_to: An event with a medium- or high-risk activity

rules.title: Insurance decided case by case
rules.owner_office: Office of Risk Management and Insurance
rules.source: USC Student Handbook 2026-27 (August 25, 2026)
rules.source_section: Appendix V: Special Event Insurance for Events on Campus
rules.source_text: Insurance requirements are determined on a case-by-case basis.
rules.message: Risk Management may require liability insurance from co-sponsors, vendors, performers and exhibitors. It decides case by case.
rules.fix_template: Ask the Office of Risk Management and Insurance whether insurance is needed, by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: An event with outside vendors, performers, co-sponsors or higher-risk activities

rules.title: Food only from approved providers; cleaning deposit
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES) Terms and Conditions 2026
rules.source_section: Terms and Conditions K: Food and Beverage
rules.source_text: K. Food and Beverage: Food and Beverages shall only be served by arrangement with an on campus food service provider, by approved USC food vendor or by approved self‐catered events. All events serving food are required to submit a cleaning deposit.
rules.message: Food may be served only by an on-campus provider, an approved USC food vendor, or an approved self-catered event. Every event with food pays a cleaning deposit.
rules.fix_template: Confirm {vendor} is an approved USC food vendor with Purchasing Services.
rules.applies_to: An event with food

rules.title: Approved USC food vendors are confirmed by phone
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES): Frequently Asked Questions
rules.source_section: Frequently Asked Questions: Who are the University approved caterers?
rules.source_text: To find out if your preferred caterer is approved please contact Purchasing Services at 213-740-2281.
rules.verification_note: USC does not publish its approved caterer list; Purchasing Services confirms a caterer by phone. Greenlight cannot check this itself.
rules.message: There is no public list of approved USC food vendors. Purchasing Services confirms a caterer by phone (213-740-2281).
rules.fix_template: Call Purchasing Services (213-740-2281) to confirm {vendor} is approved.
rules.applies_to: Checking whether a caterer is an approved USC food vendor

rules.title: Register amplified sound
rules.source: USC Student Handbook 2026-27 (August 25, 2026)
rules.source_section: Appendix V: Amplified Sound
rules.source_text: For student organization events where amplified sound is used, the event must be registered with Campus Activities (or FSL for social Greek-letter organizations).
rules.message: An event with amplified sound (microphones, speakers, a DJ, instruments) must be registered with Campus Activities.
rules.fix_template: Register the amplified sound with Campus Activities.
rules.applies_to: An event with amplified sound

rules.title: Amplified sound limit: 90 dBA
rules.source: USC Student Handbook 2026-27 (August 25, 2026)
rules.source_section: Appendix V: Amplified Sound
rules.source_text: Amplified sound cannot exceed 90 dBA, when measured 45 feet from the source.
rules.message: Amplified sound cannot be louder than 90 dBA measured 45 feet from the source.
rules.fix_template: Tell the DJ or sound vendor the 90 dBA limit.
rules.applies_to: An event with amplified sound

rules.title: Outdoor amplified sound needs Trojan Event Services approval
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES): Frequently Asked Questions
rules.source_section: Frequently Asked Questions: What is the amplified sound policy?
rules.source_text: All requests for amplification in outdoor spaces must be submitted to and approved by Trojan Event Services. The request for amplification must be on the Outdoor Reservation Request form. No two events can have amplified sound at the same time.
rules.message: Outdoor amplified sound must be requested on the Outdoor Reservation Request form and approved by Trojan Event Services; only one event at a time may have it.
rules.fix_template: Request amplified sound on the Outdoor Reservation Request form.
rules.applies_to: An outdoor event with amplified sound

rules.title: Amplified sound outside Hahn Plaza at noon is case by case
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES) Terms and Conditions 2026
rules.source_section: Terms and Conditions F.2: Amplified Sound
rules.source_text: In general, moderate amplification (not more than 90 decibels, “A” weighted, measured 45 feet from the front center of the stage) is allowed at Hahn Plaza (adjacent to Tommy Trojan) from noon to 1 p.m. Monday‐Friday. A sound check will be permitted from 11:50 a.m. to noon. All other requests for amplified sounds will be reviewed on a case‐by‐case basis by Trojan Event Services for final approval.
rules.message: Moderate amplification is generally allowed at Hahn Plaza from noon to 1 p.m., Monday to Friday. Any other time or place is decided case by case by Trojan Event Services.
rules.fix_template: Ask Trojan Event Services about amplified sound for this time and place, by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: An outdoor event with amplified sound

rules.title: Meet Campus Activities 2 weeks before a fundraiser
rules.source: USC Student Handbook 2026-27 (August 25, 2026)
rules.source_section: Sales and Fundraising by RSOs: Process
rules.source_text: a. RSOs must meet with Campus Activities at least two weeks prior to an event involving fundraising, sales, or money collections. RSOs will need approval from Campus Activities before conducting any fundraising efforts.
rules.message: For an event with fundraising, sales or money collection, meet Campus Activities at least 2 weeks before and get their approval.
rules.fix_template: Book a meeting with Campus Activities before {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: An event with fundraising, ticket sales, item sales or money collection

rules.title: Fundraising form on file with Trojan Event Services
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES) Terms and Conditions 2026
rules.source_section: Terms and Conditions P: Fundraising
rules.source_text: ii. All recognized student organizations wishing to fund‐raise must have a complete fund‐raising form on file with Trojan Event Services prior to collecting any money or goods.
rules.message: File the fundraising form with Trojan Event Services before collecting any money or goods.
rules.fix_template: Submit the Fundraising Approval Request Form.
rules.applies_to: An event with fundraising or money collection

rules.title: Cash or ticket sales at the event need approval
rules.owner_office: Trojan Event Services (TES) and Department of Public Safety (DPS)
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES) Terms and Conditions 2026
rules.source_section: Terms and Conditions O: Admissions/Ticketing
rules.source_text: All cash collection/ticket sales at the event require the approval of Trojan Event Services and the Department of Public Safety.
rules.message: Collecting cash or selling tickets at the event needs approval from Trojan Event Services and the Department of Public Safety.
rules.fix_template: Request approval for cash collection in the permit application.
rules.applies_to: An event that collects cash or sells tickets at the door

rules.title: Selling items needs Bookstore approval
rules.source: USC Student Handbook 2026-27 (August 25, 2026)
rules.source_section: Sales and Fundraising by RSOs: Process
rules.source_text: i. Item sale – Approval is required from the University Bookstore.
rules.message: Selling items on campus needs approval from the USC Bookstore, given in the permit application.
rules.fix_template: Request Bookstore approval in the University Event Permit Application.
rules.applies_to: An event that sells items

rules.title: Collecting for a non-profit: letter and meeting 2 weeks before
rules.source: USC Student Handbook 2026-27 (August 25, 2026)
rules.source_section: Non-Profit Collections
rules.source_text: RSOs collecting money/donations for specific non-profit organizations must meet with the Campus Activities at least two weeks prior to the event and upload in the UEPA portal a written letter from the non-profit organization stating their agreement to accept donations prior to the scheduled collection of any goods or funds and documentation of their tax-exempt status.
rules.message: To collect for a non-profit, meet Campus Activities at least 2 weeks before and upload a letter from the non-profit agreeing to accept the donations, with proof of its tax-exempt status.
rules.fix_template: Get the non-profit's letter and meet Campus Activities by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: An event collecting money or goods for a non-profit

rules.title: Name every co-sponsor in the permit application
rules.source: USC Student Handbook 2026-27 (August 25, 2026)
rules.source_section: RSO Co-Sponsorship
rules.source_text: For events in any campus space, the RSO must complete the University Event Permit Application. The RSO must identify the name of all proposed co-sponsors in the University Event Permit Application.
rules.message: List every co-sponsor in the University Event Permit Application.
rules.fix_template: Add {co_host} to the permit application.
rules.applies_to: A co-hosted event in campus space

rules.title: Filming needs Campus Filming Office approval
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES) Terms and Conditions 2026
rules.source_section: Terms and Conditions A.6.viii: Campus Filming Office
rules.source_text: viii. Campus Filming Office. Events being recorded and/or photographed must obtain the approval of the University Campus Filming Office. Additional broadcast and recording permits may be required.
rules.message: Events being recorded or photographed need approval from the Campus Filming Office ((213) 740-6951).
rules.fix_template: Contact the Campus Filming Office by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: An event that is filmed or recorded

rules.title: Dignitaries need Cultural Relations clearance
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES) Terms and Conditions 2026
rules.source_section: Terms and Conditions A.6.vi: Cultural Relations and University Events
rules.source_text: vi. Cultural Relations and University Events. Events involving political leaders, dignitaries, and celebrities must obtain clearance from the office of Cultural Relations and University Events.
rules.message: Events with political leaders, dignitaries or celebrities need clearance from Cultural Relations and University Events.
rules.fix_template: Contact Cultural Relations and University Events by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: An event with political leaders, dignitaries or celebrities

rules.title: Guest parking needs Transportation Services approval
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES) Terms and Conditions 2026
rules.source_section: Terms and Conditions A.6.iii: Parking
rules.source_text: iii. Parking: USC Transportation Services. An event being attended by persons coming to the University’s campus specifically for the event may require a parking reservation and must be approved by the University’s Transportation and Parking Management.
rules.message: If guests are coming to campus for the event, a parking reservation may be needed, approved by USC Transportation Services.
rules.fix_template: Contact USC Transportation Services by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: An event with guests driving to campus

rules.title: Outdoor events need Facilities Planning and Management approval
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES) Terms and Conditions 2026
rules.source_section: Terms and Conditions A.6.iv: Facilities Planning & Management
rules.source_text: iv. Facilities Planning & Management. Events taking place in outdoor areas, having special electrical or custodial needs must be approved by the University’s Facilities Planning & Management department. Fees may apply.
rules.message: Outdoor events and events with special electrical or custodial needs must be approved by Facilities Planning and Management; fees may apply.
rules.fix_template: Contact Facilities Planning and Management by {due_date}.
rules.applies_to: An outdoor event

rules.title: No advertising before the venue is confirmed in writing
rules.source: USC Student Handbook 2026-27 (August 25, 2026)
rules.source_section: Appendix V: Event Planning and Facility Reservation/Use, Scheduling
rules.source_text: No advertisement can take place before written confirmation is received.
rules.message: Do not advertise the event until the venue is confirmed in writing.
rules.fix_template: Hold the flyers until written venue confirmation arrives.
rules.applies_to: Every event in campus space

rules.title: No advertising while payments or approvals are outstanding
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES) Terms and Conditions 2026
rules.source_section: Terms and Conditions I: Promotion
rules.source_text: Purchaser may not advertise for any event in which there are outstanding payments or approvals.
rules.message: Do not advertise while any payment or approval for the event is still outstanding.
rules.fix_template: Advertise only after every payment and approval is done.
rules.applies_to: Every event booked through Trojan Event Services

rules.title: Tabling needs a daily permit
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES): Trousdale Information Tables
rules.source_section: USC Recognized Student Organization (RSO) Tabling Guidelines
rules.source_text: A valid permit is required for RSO Tabling on Trousdale Parkway or Gavin Herbert Plaza.
rules.message: Tabling on Trousdale Parkway or Gavin Herbert Plaza needs a permit from the concierge desk in Sample Hall (SKS), displayed on the table.
rules.fix_template: Pick up the tabling permit at the SKS concierge desk on the day.
rules.applies_to: Walk-up tabling

rules.title: A fundraiser at a table needs a permit application
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES): Trousdale Information Tables
rules.source_section: USC Recognized Student Organization (RSO) Tabling Guidelines
rules.source_text: The RSO table must be used for display purposes only. If it’s a student organization sponsored fundraiser, the organization must submit a university event permit application for fundraising approval. Please note that a reservation number (provided by Trojan Event Services) is needed to get the event permit.
rules.message: A tabling permit covers display only. To fundraise or sell at the table, submit a University Event Permit Application for fundraising approval; it needs a Trojan Event Services reservation number.
rules.fix_template: Get a reservation number from Trojan Event Services and submit the permit application for fundraising approval.
rules.applies_to: Walk-up tabling that raises money or sells items

rules.title: Tabling only 10 a.m. to 2 p.m., Monday to Friday
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES): Trousdale Information Tables
rules.source_section: USC Recognized Student Organization (RSO) Tabling Guidelines
rules.source_text: RSO Tabling may only happen in specific outdoor on campus locations between the hours of 10:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m. Monday through Friday.
rules.message: Tabling is allowed only from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m., Monday to Friday.
rules.fix_template: Table on a weekday between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m.
rules.applies_to: Walk-up tabling

rules.title: Tabling: 2 days in a row per week, 6 days per month
rules.source: Trojan Event Services (TES): Trousdale Information Tables
rules.source_section: Tabling FAQ: How many days can my student organization table?
rules.source_text: You can table for two (2) consecutive days per week. You can not exceed six (6) days per month.
rules.message: A club can table at most 2 consecutive days per week and 6 days per month.
rules.fix_template: Reduce tabling to 2 consecutive days a week and 6 days a month.
rules.applies_to: Walk-up tabling
